name: Air Of Authority
description: Once per round, at any time, you may lose 2 AP to provide an ally with 3 AP.

name: Alertness
description: Doubles the trigger cost of a Riposte against you during a Parry action.

name: Anatomical Insight
description: You do not suffer penalties when treating unfamiliar species.

name: Anticipation
description: Once per session, you may declare that your character had prepared for the current situation, and may have spent up to one hour for said preparation.

name: Archer
description: You are trained in using bows more proficiently. The Injuring quality increases by one level, and you need one less AP to reload and attack.

name: Assassin
description: If you attack an unaware target from out of stealth, you can increase the "Lethal" quality of your weapon by +6. If it doesn't have it, it gains Lethal (6).

name: Astrogation
description: When using FTL drives and making a Science check, you may spend one Trigger each to increase the range of the jump by +50%. If you plan to perform several chained jumps, you only make a single roll and apply the bonus to all jumps.

name: Big Boom
description: Increase the Area quality of a heavy weapons and grenades by 50% by spending 2 Triggers. Not stackable.

name: Biofeedback Shock
description: You can spend 3 Access Tokens against implanted network devices to immediately cause 12 damage (ignoring soak and armor) against the user.

name: Blackmail
description: Once per session, you may produce blackmail about one NPC and use it against them to coerce them to do something for you.

name: Blend In
description: If you are in a public space among bystanders or crowds, others suffer a -5 pool penalty to notice you.

name: Bountyhunter's Guild
description: Once per adventure, you may pull a target from the list of wanted individuals. You obtain a target that is close to you, and that yields 1d6 Assets upon execution. You may cooperate on the execution, and any accomplices gain 1 Asset in addition.

name: Brace For Impact
description: You unlock a new action for ship combat: You can spend 4 AP to brace the systems of your ship for impact. Perform a Tech d3 roll. If you succeed, reduce the pool of all malfunction rolls for this and the next round by 3.

name: Breath In, Exhale, Fire
description:
If you can see your target, you can perform this action by spending 3 AP to gain a free success, trigger or complication on your next shot against them.
If you perform any other action in the meantime, the benefit is lost.

name: Call Target
description: You may spend 4 AP and perform a Command d2 check. If you succeed, all attacks against your called target gain a free Trigger for this and the next round.

name: Cash Flow
description: After each adventure, you obtain 2d6 * 100 Credits from royalties or dividents.

name: Charge
description: You can perform a melee attack and increase the AP costs by +2 to first move a number of squares equal to your speed. If you moved at least 5 squares to reach your target, you gain 2 free triggers on the attack.

name: Chart Comprehension
description: Once per adventure, you may perform an Investigation or Sensors d3 check. On a success, you become aware of a rare point of interest that may hold secrets or riches.

name: Climber
description: You reduce the difficulty to climb by 2 and halve the time it takes to climb. Additionally, reduce the distance class of any fall by 2.

name: Combat Clarity
description: Once per encounter, you may immediately gain 2 AP.

name: Combat Docking
description: Halve all pool penalties of the Dock action, and your crew gains +2 pool on their first attack upon boarding.

name: Concealed Approach
description: Enemies suffer -4 pool to discover your vehicle when you have means to hide it (e.g. a space ship inside a gas giant, or a car in the woods).

name: Concealment
description: When attempting to hide in a stationary position, or when hiding objects, you gain gain +3 pool. If the thing still gets discovered against your will, you re-gain one edge point.

name: Connections
description: Once per session, you are guaranteed to find a seller / buyer for an item that you want to buy or sell. Only possible when there is reasonable civilization nearby.

name: Cover Ducking
description: Once per round, if you benefit from cover, you may attempt to dodge that attack without AP cost.

name: Custom Model
description: You may apply a unique modification to one of your drones that you won't have to pay for. Talk to the GM to come up with ideas. If the drone is lost, you may reapply that same modification to another drone.

name: Cyberadaption Training
description: You gain +4 Cyberimmunity.

name: Cybernetic Maintenance
description: Reduce the difficulty of tech checks to repair cyberware by 1.

name: Cybernetic Overload
description: By spending an edge point you may double the effectiveness of a piece of cyberware in your body for the remainder of the encounter. If used outside of an encounter, the overload lasts for 5 Minutes. When the effect ends, roll once on your cyberware malfunction table.

name: Cybersecurity Specialist
description: You can attempt to hack an enemy system with -2 Firewall and IC Level. On that roll, you can spend resulting Access Tokens only on the the "Cancel" hacking option.

name: Danger Sense
description: You convert three dice from your vigilance rolls into expertise dice when you need to perceive danger or threats.

name: Defensive Posture
description: If you attempted a parry or dodge but still get hit, you gain +2 soak.

name: Demand Obedience
description: You may perform a Command d3 check against a neutral NPC or bystander. If you succeed, that NPC will perform one helpful action, plus another action for every surplus success. In combat, you need to spend 6 AP and have a range of 10.

name: Diplomatic Immunity
description: Once per session, you can make your diplomatic immunity known. Due to the resulting hesitation of enemies, they require +1 success to hit you, and you reduce all injury rolls by 3 dice (to a Minimum of 0).

name: Directional Explosions
description: When using a heavy weapon or grenade, after determining the affected Area of a weapon with that quality, you can remove 2 affected squares and instead affect 2 other squares, so long as they are connected to the remaining Area.

name: Disposable Drone Army
description: Declare a drone with a base value of 3000 Credits or less. After each adventure, if that drone got destroyed, you get a free repair or even replacement, including any mounted weapons and upgrades.

name: Drone Fixer
description: Reduce the difficulty to repair your drones by 1 and halve the resources required.

name: Drug Expert
description: If you administer drugs, you may attempt a Medicine d2 check. If you succeed, the target may ignore any draw backs or risks of addiction.

name: Drug Manufacturing
description: As a downtime activity, if you have access to a lab, you may perform a Science d0 check. For each success you may create one drug of your choice (e.g. Stim Pack, Pain Meds. etc). You have to pay half the price of the item in raw materials.

name: Dual Wield
description: You can perform an attack with two one-handed weapons (or fists) at once. Pay the full AP costs of one weapon, and half the AP costs (round down) of the other. You make two separate attacks.

name: Effective Demolition
description: When using heavy weapons or grenades, you gain one free trigger on each roll to attack.

name: Effective Navigation
description: When performing the Maneuver action, you may accept a -1 pool penalty to then gain either +1 speed or +1 maneuverability.

name: Efficient Subroutines
description: You can spend the first 2 Triggers of any hacking attempt to gain an additional Access Token.

name: Efficient Treatment
description: When performing First Aid, you may count every Trigger as an additional success.

name: Embracing Chaos
description: You may perform a new reaction during combat: If you get affected by a weapon with the "Area" quality, you may spend 2 AP to halve the damage before applying it to your armor and health.

name: Emergency Evasion
description: Once per encounter, you can perform the Evade action without having to spend Action Points, and add +5 pool to that attempt.

name: Evasive
description: You remove the default -3 pool penalty for your dodge & parry checks, and you can perform one dodge or parry per round for only 1 AP cost instead of 2.

name: Evasive Positioning
description: When you perform the Evade ship action, you gain +1 Soak against that attack for every Trigger rolled (you can spend them on other things).

name: Experimental Upgrade
description: You may apply a unique upgrade to one of your ship's modules. If the module is ever destroyed or lost, you may create a different, new one as a downtime activity.

name: Expert Jury-Rigger
description: You reduce the difficulty of the Jury-Rig action, as well as the Repair Ship downtime activity by 1.

name: Exploit Weakspot
description: You may give yourself a -2 pool penalty before your melee attack, but the attack gains Penetrating (+3) and Murderous. The latter applies even if the target is aware of the attack.

name: Far Shot
description: Increase the upper ranges (optimal and maximum) of all firearms you use by 30%. When shooting within max range, you suffer -1 pool penalty instead of +1 difficulty.

name: Fasthack
description: When you perform Probed Hacking, you halve the time required.

name: Field Doctor
description: Medicine checks to provide First Aid only require 5 instead of 8 AP.

name: Fighter Piloting
description: When performing the Maneuver action, you may spend 2 Triggers. If you do, you reduce the AP cost of your next vehicle / space combat action by the AP cost of your maneuver action.

name: First Impression
description:
If you meet an NPC for the first time, you may attempt an Empathy d3 check.
If you succeed, the NPC will meet you with a friendlier demeanor (which may benefit further social checks).

name: Flight Tracking
description: When using the Calculate Flight Path ship action, you may ignore the first 3 vessels before you increase the difficulty of the check.

name: Flurry
description: You can halve the AP costs of your melee attack (round up), but need to accept a -2 pool penalty.

name: Galaxy-Wide Fans
description: Once per session, you may declare an NPC to be a fan of your art. They will do their best to help or comfort you.

name: Gamer Mindset
description: When controlling a drone through a VR Headset, reduce the AP cost of all actions by 1 (to a minimum of 2).

name: Grand Theft Ship
description: You become a member of an esteemed underworld ring of pirates. You can bring them stolen ships to gain 20% of that ship's total asset value, no questions asked.

name: Grip On Life
description: Triple the duration of the "Dying" condition when you suffer from it. Additionally, you can ignore the "Unconscious" condition, but suffer +1 difficulty on all actions.

name: Gun Nut
description:
The difficulty to modify or repair firearms is reduced by 1.
Additionally, you only need half the usual AP costs to fix minor issues (like jamming) during an encounter.

name: Haggler
description: Instead of rolling to negotiate, you may reduce the asset / credits cost of all things you buy by a flat 20%.

name: Heavy Blow
description: You may double the AP costs of your melee attack, but if successfull, you gain 3 free triggers.

name: Helping Hand
description: Whenever you support another character in a task, you may use your expertise in Command instead of using the involved skill. Additionally, you roll one additional die when supporting.

name: Impenetrable Shell
description: The weapon qualities Penetrating and Shredding are halved when used against you.

name: Inheritance
description: You immediately obtain 20 Assets.

name: Intimidation
description: You may attempt a Command d3 check by spending 4 AP against a target in range 10. If you succeed, the target immediately loses 4 AP.

name: Iron Skin
description: Gain +1 soak and +4 maximum health.

name: Iron Wall
description: After your second parry during the same round, further parry actions cost 1 less AP.

name: Irreproducible Prototype
description: You obtain one weapon, gagdet, tool, armor or drone that you personally made, but are unable to mass-produce. If your prototype is ever destroyed, you may come up with a completely new prototype by spending a downtime activity.

name: Jack Of All Trades
description: After rolling, you may spend an Edge point to add a Complication to any roll. Additionally, increase your maximum edge points by +1.

name: Jerryrigging
description: You can spend an Edge point to improvise a temporary tool, item or other aid. It provides someone with a +1 pool bonus for a given skill, or can substitute any low-tech item worth 200 credits or less. The item becomes unusable after one scene.

name: Juiced Up
description: When performing First Aid, you can spend one Trigger to provide the target with +1 Soak and +2 pool bonus to all physical checks for this and the next round.

name: Killer Instincts
description: You gain +1 Heft for your melee attacks.

name: Lethal Attacks
description: If you cause an injury roll, the target adds three dice to that roll.

name: Linguist
description: Immediately determine two additional languages which you now speak fluently.

name: Linked Control
description: You can actively control two drones at once. Whenever you perform an action, you have to perform the same action with the other drone as well (or skip it on the 2nd drone). You only spend Action Points once - if the Action Point cost would differ, you spend the higher cost between the two.

name: Living Shadow
description: When you are surrounded by darkness, you gain +1 defense and reduce the difficulty of infiltration and skullduggery tests by 1.

name: Lockpicker
description: You reduce the difficulty to pick mechanical and technological locks by 1.

name: Lurking Death
description: If you incapacitate or kill a target from out of stealth, you may make an Infiltration d3 roll. On a success, you remain stealthed. You may also spend a trigger to immediately hide the body.

name: Malfunction Resilience
description: Once per session, you may ignore all Cyber Malfunction symbols of a given injury roll.

name: Martial Artist
description: Treat your unarmed attacks like a 2-handed weapon (concerning Heft) and add the Murderous trigger option. Additionally, you can parry real weapons even while being unarmed.

name: Master Detective
description: Once per session, you may produce a clue for a crime scene (or similar) that will help you progress.

name: Master Of Improvisation
description: If you spend an edge point on a Tech check, you gain +2 pool (even if you used the edge point to just get a re-roll).

name: Merchant's Guild
description: You treat the rarity of all items as if it was 2 lower, and you gain an additional 10% discount.

name: Mind Reader
description: Once per session, you may attempt an Empathy d3 check and target an individual. On a success, you get to know the true emotional state and vague intent of that individual. You also get to anticipate their next action.

name: Minion Master
description: Increase the AI values of your drones by +1 | +1.

name: Miracle Worker
description: Once per week, instead of rolling your Medicine check, you may treat it as if you had rolled 5 successes.

name: Mirror
description: You can perfectly imitate voices and mannerisms of others after you heard & saw them for a while, adding +5 pool on Infiltration tests when you impersonate them.

name: Mob Of Fans
description: If you are in a public area, once per session, you may trigger a mob of fans to appear and help you. They will either cause a helpful distraction or even fight for you (within reason).

name: Monitoring
description: Whenever a device gains an access token on your system, the DM may make a secret Computers check for you. If you have at least 4 successes, you become aware of the attempt and the network address of the attacker.

name: Monkey Patch
description: You unlock a new action for ship combat: You can spend 8 AP to perform a Tech d0 check. For each success, your ship regains 2 hull points, but reduces its maximum hull by 1 until it received major maintenance at a space port. You may also spend one Trigger each to restore one armor durability.

name: Motivational Speech
description: Once per session, you can spend 30 minutes and make an Empathy d0 check. For each success, you may restore one Edge point among those who observe you - distribute as you like.

name: Multi-Rigger
description: When attempting the Jury-Rig action, you may attempt to repair two systems at once, but increase the difficulty of both rolls by +1.

name: Multitasking Admiral
description: Once per round, you can spend 1 AP to make a supporting skill check to aid any one allied crew member in their next task. Additionally, increase the multitasking capacity of your ship's AI by +1.

name: Notorious Liar
description: Once per day you may declare a lie as being so bullet-proof that no test is necessary to make NPCs believe it.

name: Overload
description: You can spend 4 Access Tokens on a target device to destroy it, making longer repairs necessary before it functions again.

name: Perfected Ship Care
description: Declare one ship that you regularly spend time on. That ship reduces the accumulated pool modifier from suffered malfunctions by 4 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Perimeter Scan
description: You can spend an hour and make a Sensors d0 roll to scan an compound. For each sucess, you gain one Edge Point that can only be spent on the next scene within that compound. You can spend such Edge Points to produce facts about the compound, e.g. special exits or similar.

name: Permit Collection
description: Nothing you carry on your ship can be marked as illegal, and you can demand docking rights on any official space port.

name: Personal Protection
description: Once per adventure, you may demand up to two police officers or similar to accompany you for the duration of a scene. They are obligated to protect you with their life.

name: Phantom Scan
description: You can use the Scan Interior ship action even if the target vessel has active shields and others have to perform a Sensors d4 check to even notice your scan.

name: Phishing Network
description: When your system gets compromised, there is a 50% chance that the countering system locates a wrong device (of an innocent bystander).

name: Point Blank
description: You reduce the difficulty increase of your ranged attacks while being near melee fighters to +1 instead of +2. Additionally, deal +2 damage (with ranged attacks) against targets within range 2.

name: Point Defense
description: If you use the "Point Defense" weapon quality of a space ship weapon, you reduce the difficulty to hit a missile or torpedo by 2.

name: Police Handler
description: Whenever you need to deal with police or other officials, you gain +4 pool on any checks to get away without problems.

name: Precision Trauma
description: When attacking biological entities, you may spend one Trigger each to add +1 injury die.

name: Pull Together
description: Once per day, you can declare any one wound you are suffering from and ignore its effects for the remainder of that day (so long as it is technically possible - you cannot ignore that you lost an arm).

name: Quickfingers
description: Gain a +3 pool bonus to pickpocketing or sleight of hand checks, and halve the AP costs to reload pistols, revolvers and MPs (round up).

name: Quick Recovery
description: Treating or regenerating your injuries has -1 difficulty.

name: Quick Reload
description:
Reduce the AP costs to reload any firearms weapon by 1.

For firearms that load individual shells, you instead load 2 shells per action spent.

name: Quick Witted
description: You only need to spend 1 AP to ready your weapon instead of 3, and your first attack of a given encounter gains +2 pool.

name: Rank and File
description: You may draft 2 NPCs that will serve you as crew members. They have all attributes on level 4 and expertise 1 in all relevant skills. Choose 2 skills for each of them which they gain +2 expertise in. They can perform the "Train Skill" downtime activity a number of times based on your own level.

name: Reanimation
description: If the target has been dead for less than 5 minutes, you may attempt a Medicine check with difficulty 5. On a success, the target is successfully reanimated, but will be uncapable to actively act for at least one hour.

name: Reboot Shield Matrix
description: Once per encounter, you can spend 6 AP to perform a Tech d0 check. For each success, your ship regains 5 shield points.

name: Recoil Control
description: When shooting in Burst or Full Auto mode, you require 40% less ammo (round up).

name: Relentless Pursuit
description: If you pursue a target that tries to escape, you can spend an edge point and then make a roll on Infiltration, Athletics or Acrobatics to create a shortcut, distraction or other helpful aid to make your pursuit a success.

name: Resourceful
description: Increase your maximum edge points by +3.

name: Riposte
description: When you perform the Parry action, you only require one Trigger to perform the counter attack, and you may spend surplus triggers (after the needed Trigger for the counter attack) as usual to activate talents or your weapon's trigger options.

name: Ripper
description: If you attack an unaware target from out of stealth, you can spend 2 Triggers to immediately make them roll for injury as if they had 0 health. You also bypass their armor. You can spend one additional trigger each to add +3 injury dice.

name: Rush In
description: When you perform a Maneuver action, all ranged attacks against you have +2 difficulty until the rest of the round.

name: Saboteur
description: Gain a +3 pool bonus on checks to sabotage equipment or machinery. Sabotaged items malfunction in a specified way, and the malfunction isn't immediately obvious.

name: Salvager
description: When repairing systems or equipment, you only need half the materials.

name: Sample Collector
description: You gain access to a new downtime activity so long as you are on a planet or large asteroid: you may perform a Survival d0 check. For each success you collect a unique mineral or plant sample that you can sell for 75 Credits each.

name: Second Skin
description: Ignore the speed penalty while wearing armor and increase the maximum durability of worn armor by +25%.

name: Secret Stash
description: After each adventure, roll 1d6 and multiply the result by 100. Track the result and add it to a new total. At any point during a session you may claim knowledge about a secret stash nearby. It contains items but you have to spend Credits from the pool of this talent to pay for them.

name: Seducer
description: Once per session, you may use seduction as a component of your Con Arts check - you must announce the use before the roll. If you do, you may re-roll the check once and keep the better result.

name: Self-Treatment
description: You may ignore the penalty to perform First Aid or Surgery on yourself.

name: Space Port Owner
description: You may spend 10 Assets to become a board member of a large space station. All services at that station provide you with a 50% discount, and you generate 3d6 x 100 Credits (or 1d6 Assets) in cash flow after each adventure through dividends.

name: Specialized Gunner
description: Choose a specific type of ship weapon (e.g. laser, missile, railgun etc.) upon learning this talent. You always gain 1 free trigger when attacking with that weapon.

name: Speed Trigger
description: Once per round, you can spend 2 Triggers on a firearms related attack (so long as you do not shoot in Burst or Full Auto) to immediately perform a free single shot against the same target - you have to roll the attack as usual and spend additional ammo.

name: Sprinter
description: You passively gain +3 speed.

name: Spy
description: When you hide listening bugs or espionage viruses, you gain +3 pool to hide them well.

name: Steady Aim
description:
If you used the "Prepare" action at least twice, you also add a free trigger to the attack.

Additionally, you can stack the bonus from "Prepare" up to +5.

name: Sterilization
description: When you perform Surgery, you can spend one Trigger each to provide the target with +2 pool during its next rest, or an additional 10% health recovered.

name: Stock Broker
description: As a downtime activity, you can obtain one asset by only spending 1500 Credits. When making one asset fluid, you obtain 1000 Credits instead. Additionally, you may perform 1d6 conversions per downtime instead of just one.

name: Stroke of Genius
description: Once per session, you may request the GM to provide insight on a current scientific or technological problem.

name: Sub-System Targeting
description: You may spend one Trigger on your gunnery checks. If the target ship suffers a malfunction, you may choose a malfunction within the rolled severity level.

name: Surgeon
description: Reduce the difficulty of checks during surgery by 1. Alternatively you may halve the time.

name: Sweep
description: When you perform a melee attack, you can spend 1 Trigger each to hit an additional target within range for half the damage - you do not apply other trigger options to those hits.

name: Synergetic Installation
description: All cyberware you install costs 25% less occupation (round down).

name: System Hardening
description: As a new downtime activity, you may declare one device. You install custom subroutines, permanently granting that device +1 Firewall and +1 IC Level. Cannot be stacked multiple times on the same device.

name: System Redundancies
description:
Increase the maximum integrity your device can suffer before becoming compromised by 30%.
Additionally reduce the difficulty to restore your device by 1.

name: Tactical Advance
description: Once per round, when you perform a reload or attack action with a firearm, your free movement becomes half your speed (round up) instead of just 1.

name: Tactical Commander
description: You may distribute the generated triggers from "Assist" freely among team members, and you may convert your own triggers into successes on a 1:1 basis (instead of 2:1).

name: Take What's Needed
description: After looting an enemy or pickpocketing someone, you can spend Edge points to claim that they had specific items on them which you now possess. The value of the items is 100 Credits per Edge point spent. The GM can refuse this.

name: Third Wind
description: You can use the "Second Wind" action up to twice per day, and halve its AP costs.

name: Thug Language
description: If you become threatened or provoked by thugs, bandits or similar scum, you gain +4 pool for any attempts to avoid conflict.

name: Tinkerer
description: You may declare one personal weapon or armor that gains +1 Mod Slot, and a unique modification that you invented. Due to the quirkiness of the modification, only you can make use of it.

name: Tough As Nails
description: Ignore the first severity 1 or 2 wound of each day by simply discarding it.

name: Tracker
description: When you attempt to track a person or creature, you gain a +3 Pool Modifier and you gain +2 Vigilance while tracking your target.

name: Training: Agility
description: Gain +1 Agility. If you already have 8 Agility (not counting cybernetic enhancements), you may increase another attribute instead.

name: Training: Constitution
description: Gain +1 Constitution. If you already have 8 Constitution (not counting cybernetic enhancements), you may increase another attribute instead.

name: Training: Coolness
description: Gain +1 Coolness. If you already have 8 Coolness (not counting cybernetic enhancements), you may increase another attribute instead.

name: Training: Education
description: Gain +1 Education. If you already have 8 Education (not counting cybernetic enhancements), you may increase another attribute instead.

name: Training: Intelligence
description: Gain +1 Intelligence. If you already have 8 Intelligence (not counting cybernetic enhancements), you may increase another attribute instead.

name: Training: Personality
description: Gain +1 Personality. If you already have 8 Personality (not counting cybernetic enhancements), you may increase another attribute instead.

name: Training: Strength
description: Gain +1 Strength. If you already have 8 Strength (not counting cybernetic enhancements), you may increase another attribute instead.

name: Trigger Discipline
description: If you successfully attack, you may convert up to 2 surplus successes into one trigger each instead.

name: Unkillable Beast
description: Reduce the pool of all injury rolls by 4 dice, to a minimum of 1.

name: Unpredictable Aim
description: When targets attempt to actively dodge your shots, they suffer a -2 pool penalty.

name: Vanish
description: You can spend an edge point to make an infiltration roll against the best vigilance pool among your enemies. If you succeed, you cause a distraction and become practically undetectable for one round.

name: Vehicle Specialization
description:
Gain +2 pool when operating a type of vehicle that you need to declare upon obtaining this talent:
Ground Vehicles, Atmospheric Vehicle, Space Ships or Drones.

name: Weakspot Analysis
description: When attacking mechanical entities and you make them roll for malfunction, they add +3 dice.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Choose a specific melee weapon upon learning this talent. You always gain 1 free trigger when attacking with that weapon.

name: White Lies
description: Everyone who tries to uncover or see through your lies suffers a -3 pool penalty on any test relevant to the lie.

name: Will To Survive
description: Halve the injury modifiers that you receive from injuries (add them all up, then halve, round up).

name: Wonder Doctor
description: You can perform Surgery and First Aid up to twice per patient per day / encounter.

name: Xeno Engineer
description: You do not suffer penalties when you use or repair alien technology.

name: Zero-G Finesse
description: You ignore penalties on physical actions resulting from Zero-G environments.
